info.name: 3. Distribution REST APIs By Module
info.description:
#### ORACLE Hospitality Distribution Rest APIs

This Postman Collection offers many API call samples for the Oracle Hospitality Distribution REST APIs. For more information on Oracle Distribution visit [Oracle Hospitality Distribution](https://www.oracle.com/au/industries/hospitality/products/hotel-channel-management-software/) .

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
This is required to access the OPERA Cloud Distribution REST APIs.

The username and password for Distribution API are provided by Oracle Hospitality Distribution channel onboarding process, by Oracle, along with your channelCode.

### Obtaining a token

To obtain a token include the following body parameters:

- **username**. set this to your OPERA Cloud Distribution username.
    
- **password**. Set this to your OPERA Cloud Distribution user's password.

item.description:
A valid bearer token is required to access the OPERA Cloud Distribution REST APIs.  
The username and password for Distribution API are provided by Oracle Hospitality Distribution channel onboarding process, by Oracle, along with your channelCode.  

To obtain a token include the following body parameters:  
**username**. set this to your OPERA Cloud Distribution username.  
**password**. Set this to your OPERA Cloud Distribution user's password.

item.description:
**OPERA Cloud Distribution Content API.**

The API offers an easy way to connect to properties in order to retrieve Content and product mapping if applicable.

A channel can request a list of all properties connected via OPERA Cloud Distribution for a given channel code.

For each property the following information can be retrieved.

The message types are:  
• Property Information (Address, timezone, latitude/longitude, property amenities and other descriptive content.  
• Guestrooms (Channel Room Type) information such as room descriptions, amenities, occupancies.  
• Rate Plans (Channel Rate Plan) information such as rate descriptions, mealplan, OTA rate plan types.  
• Rate Rooms can also be used for channels needing room-rate mapping available for their channel, including room occupancies.

item.description:
**OPERA Cloud Distribution Shop API.**

The API offers an easy way to connect to properties in order to shop available rates and rooms.

A typical shopping flow starts with Property Search to find available properties in a certain rate range, followed by a Property Offers request to get the available rates and rooms at selected property.  
Finally, a Get Offer request will return all the details needed for a specific offer before user decides to make a booking.

For single property, it is also possible to request availability for specific stay criteria during a specific date range of possible arrival dates (Calendar)

The message types are:  
• Property search -get availability status for multiple properties.  
• Property offers -search available offers at single property  
• Property Get offer -get details on specified property, rate and room  
• Property Calendar -list available offers as a calendar for specified property

item.description:
**OPERA Cloud Distribution Book API.**

The API offers a distribution channel an easy way to book a property.

A typical booking flow starts with Shop requests to find available properties. Once a property offer is identified, the Book requests can be used to create, retrieve, modify and cancel reservations in OPERA Cloud via Distribution APIs.

Book request does not require to pass any price or policy information as those will be calculated by OPERA Cloud during the Book response. Based on availability and applicable policy requirements for a given stay, Book may reject the request in case property, specific offer or type of guarantee is not available.

The Book operations are used in case the booking is created only in OPERA Cloud.

If you are looking for API that will simply allow channel to deliver a reservation already committed to guest in another system, you will prefer OPERA Cloud Distribution Reservation Notification.

Note that same channel code can not use both Book and Reservation Notification. This is channel specific configuration discussed during channel onboarding.

The different operations allow to:  
• Create reservation  
• Modify reservation  
• Retrieve reservation  
• Cancel reservation

Optional:  
• In-session with Commit and Ignore operations. This is used only if channel uses a two-step approach to create, modify or cancel a booking. First an API call is done to create a reservation "in session" which means confirmation number is generated and inventory is hold but reservation will not be saved until an explicit "Commit" request is sent subsquently. "Ignore" can be sent to discard the reservation in session and inventory will be released back to hotel. Same apply for modifications and cancellations. The in-session requests are ideal when orchestrating multiple bookings (shopping cart).

item.description:
**OPERA Cloud Distribution Reservation Notification API.**

The API offers a distribution channel an easy way to deliver a reservation alreayd committed in another system.

Reservation Notification is meant to accept the rates and stay details even if the offer is set as different price or not available in OPERA Cloud. Those reservations being already committed to the guests, they must be delivered to OPERA Cloud.

The different operations allow to:  
• Create reservation  
• Modify reservation  
• Retrieve reservation  
• Cancel reservation

item.description:
Designed for booking engine “direct” channels powered by hotel supplier, that require both the simplicity of distribution mapping and the depth of PMS functionality.

It merges the strengths of the distribution layer, such as channel mapping, degraded mode, with the advanced reservation capabilities of the PMS, including internal operational features typically available to hotel users.

This flexibility makes it ideal for hotel developers or vendor partners building fully flexible guest-facing applications that demand comprehensive booking features, beyond what standard distribution APIs allow.

Overview of Distribution APIs

# Distribution Content

APi used by any channel to retreive static hotel information, such as descriptions, guest rooms or rate plans. a channel code is required.

In addition, based on your channel code there is two different ways to integrate with OPERA Cloud Distribution APIs for ARI and Reservation flows below.

# 1) Shop and Book

Used by booking engines, GDS and other channels creating reservation directly in OPERA Cloud. The availbility is also retreived from OPERA Cloud, and no ARI data is "pushed" to the channel.

- **SHOP** Availability is retrieved from OPERA Cloud Distribution
    
- **BOOK** Reservation requests are accepted or rejected based on dates, rates and guarantee availability. Prices are calculated by OPERA Cloud Distribution in real time.
    

# 2) ARI "Push" and Reservation Notification

Typically used by Online Travel Agencies, Channel managers, when channel creates booking in their system and simply need to deliver booking in OPERA Cloud

- **ARI PUBLICATION** Availability is published to the channel and data is stored in the channel system
    
    - Basic functionality: ARI messages for Inventory, Rates and Restrictions.
        
    - Additional features: Onboarding and Content notification for faster onboarding.
        
- **RESERVATION NOTIFICATION:** Because the guest already received confirmation from the channel systen, OEPRA Cloud Distribution Reservation Notification accepts rates, guarantee from the channel, even if different or not available in OPERA Cloud Distribution.

item.description:
Restrictions are always published at Room Type - Rate Plan code level. If hotelier creates one single "house level" restriction, a room type - rate code restriction will be sent for all the rate plans and room types. Similarly, if restrictions are managed at rate category level, a room type - rate code restriction will be sent for all the rate plans associated with this category in OPERA and their associated room types.

Following Restriction Types are supported

- Restrictions Statuses
    
    - Open / Close (Restriction: Master)
        
    - Close to Arrival (Restriction: Arrival)
        
    - Close to Departure (Restriction: Departure)
        
    - Mininum Advanced Booking (minAdvancedBookingOffset)
        
    - Maximum Advanced Booking (maxAdvancedBookingOffset)
        
- Length of Stay restrictions
    
    - Minimum Stay Through restriction (ForwardMinStay)
        
    - Minimum Length of Stay restriction (MinLOS)
        
    - Maximum Stay Through restriction (ForwardMaxStay)
        
    - Maximum Length of Stay restriction (MaxLOS)
        

**Important: Each restriction message is a full overlay of the above restrictions values for a given hotel, room type, rate plan, date range and day of week. If certain restrictions are not included in the message, this should be considered as cleared in the target system.**

Examples:

- In certain Distribution versions, Min Length of Stay (MinLOS) may not always be present. If Minimum Length of Stay (MinLOS) is not present in restriction message the target system should treat this as MinLOS with value of 1.
    
- If MaxLOS is not present in the message, it means no Maximum Length of stay exists.

item.description: Oracle Hospitality Distribution ARI publication message specification for distribution partners to receive in real time property restrictions/availability, rate, and inventory schedules updates, also known as ARI. Partner receives this message will respond with success or error/warning so that property/CRS user can see the status of message delivery in OPERA. A channel code identifier is required in Oracle Hospitality Distribution to receive those messages.

item.name: Rate Plans and Rate-Room Notification
item.description:
Outbound Notification message from Oracle to partner when a property enables, updates a rate plans for a channel.  

**Only channel supporting ARI Publication (ARI Push) can receive Content notification, and if Content notification URL is provided to Oracle**.

The Content and Onboarding Notification messages are new messages sent to channel partners to notify them about creation, update and delete actions in channel configuration or property content. Those notifications are light weight message sent to partner when events occur in OPERA Cloud. Message will always contain a **meta-data** section, as well as **transaction key** section that will help the channel know how to call back Distribution APIs and get the full information. - moduleName: type of module. For channels it will always be "ChannelContent" - actionType: identifies the entity where create, update or delete happened - CREATE/UPDATE CHANNEL PROPERTY: used to notify when a hotel user associates their property to a channel, also to notifit about property information content update (Hotel address, contact, etc..) - UPDATE CHANNEL CONTROLS: used to notify when a hotel user updates channel property controls (settings) specific to a given channel. - CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE CHANNEL ROOM TYPE: used to notify when a guest room (room Type) is added to channel, updated or deleted. - CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE CHANNEL RATE PLAN: used to notify when a rate plan code is added to channel, updated or deleted. - CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE CHANNEL RATE ROOM: used to notify when a room type and rate plan code association is created, updated or deleted for a given property and channel. - UPDATE CHANNEL PROPERTY: used to notify when a hotel user decides to activate a channel for go live, or inactivate a channel. Status can be NEW, TEST, ACTIVE, MAINTENANCE or INACTIVE. A channel partner can only update status to TEST or MAINTENANCE, if only if current status is NEW or TEST. - timestamp: timestamp on when the message is created for channel partner - enterpriseId: OPERA Cloud Enterprise ID for the given OPERA Cloud hotel. (For information) - hotelCode: HotelCode for channel partner (globally unique) - channelCode: channel code for channel affected by change notification (Oracle code) - name: Name of the entity the field passed to the channel partner - value: Value of this field. **Only channel supporting ARI Publication (ARI Push) can receive Content notification, and if Content notification URL is provided to Oracle**.

item.description:
Oracle Hospitality Distribution External Lookup is to get rate plan and room types from external channel partners.

Partners supporting this specifications will be able to return a list of room types or rate plans from their system to present in OPERA Cloud Distribution list of values for channel mapping and offer better user experience for hotels.

**Partner must provide URL to Oracle for OPERA Cloud Distribution to call and return results in the OPERA Cloud user interface.**
